Compute cumulative incidence for competing risks

Source: R/estimands.R
survkit_cuminc.Rd

The Aalen-Johansen estimator of the cumulative incidence function for each competing event, computed from a multi-state survival::survfit(). Unlike one minus a cause-specific Kaplan-Meier, this accounts for the competing events and so sums, across causes, to the overall failure probability.

Usage

survkit_cuminc(formula, data, ...)

Arguments

formula

A model formula whose response is a multi-state survival::Surv(time, event) with event a factor whose first level is censoring. The right-hand side is 1 or grouping variables.

data

A data frame.

...

Passed to survival::survfit().

Value

A data frame with time, group (the stratum, or "all"), cause, cif (the cumulative incidence) and cif_se (its standard error).

See also

survkit() with method = "fine_gray" for a regression on the subdistribution hazard.

Other model-fitting: is_survkit_refusal(), survkit(), survkit_power(), survkit_refusal(), survkit_rmst(), survkit_score(), survkit_triangulate()

Examples

mg <- survival::mgus2
mg$etime <- with(mg, ifelse(pstat == 1, ptime, futime))
mg$event <- with(mg, factor(ifelse(pstat == 1, "pcm",
                            ifelse(death == 1, "death", "censor")),
                            levels = c("censor", "pcm", "death")))
ci <- survkit_cuminc(survival::Surv(etime, event) ~ 1, mg)
head(ci)
#>   time group cause         cif      cif_se
#> 1    1   all   pcm 0.000000000 0.000000000
#> 2    2   all   pcm 0.001446164 0.001021853
#> 3    3   all   pcm 0.001446164 0.001021853
#> 4    4   all   pcm 0.002169246 0.001251056
#> 5    5   all   pcm 0.002892329 0.001444071
#> 6    6   all   pcm 0.003615411 0.001613935
